text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's been pretty busy lately!
I really feel like I'm giving it my all with tons of energy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's give it our all again today~!
How about we tidy up these shelves real quick? ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Whoops... Sorry, sorry, it slipped out of my hand!
Nothing's broken though, so it's all good!
I'll be more careful!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um, this goes in this drawer...
—Ouch!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's fine, totally fine!
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Mega Auspicious☆
I'm in tip-top shape today too~!

“...It clearly looks like she's putting on a brave face.
Running consecutive races lately might be taking its toll on her...
I should adjust the schedule.”
